title: Capstone validation and deployment
hypothesis: The full stack (base → meta → regime → 8% vol) passes every gate together.
question: Does the complete enhanced book pass the alpha gate as one system, and should we lever it up in calm markets?
prior: Components validated separately can interact; the stack must be tested whole.
method: Full stack on the June cache, 2007 →; MC, crisis windows, alpha gate.
Tested a calm-market leverage boost and dynamic vol targeting.
verdict_reason: Passed and deployed: Sharpe 1.25, MaxDD −5.4% at native ~3% vol (Sharpe 1.24, MaxDD about −13.5% at 8% vol). The calm-market boost dropped Sharpe 1.22 → 0.86 and was rejected.
lessons: Levering up in calm markets concentrates tail risk; only asymmetric de-risking held up.

extra_tables.title: Rejected: lever up in calm markets
